question: In which of the following States 'Hirakund' dam is situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Hirakund Dam** is constructed across the river **Mahanadi**.

 
 
• Hirakud Dam is close to Sambalpur city in **Odisha**__.
 
• It is one of the first major multipurpose river valley projects that started after India's independence.
 
• It began its operations in **1957**.
 
• The total length of the Hirakund Dam is 25.79 km.
